parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, no documented police targeting, custody rule or violence campaign; the single documented violence case (2018) drew an official response (guards dismissed). Visitor-facing exposure rests on the May 2025 border mockery incident with no recourse, plus a state censorship regime reaching public expression (rainbow symbols banned even inside venues, Pride/performances cancelled, accounts scrubbed in 2026) — state threat-framing of gender-nonconforming expression that a visibly trans visitor can encounter. There is no protective machinery: no anti-discrimination law, no hate-crime coverage, no LGR, LGBTI groups unregistrable. Conversion therapy remains routine (mainly resident-facing). Social opinion is moderately accepting (majority marriage support). Border document-marker practice and custody placement are unresolved open questions, not exposures. Absence of a documented universal facility/custody/search rule keeps this above the 0.45 tier; absent protections and undocumented recourse hold it below reduced-risk bands.
